name: Venom, Evil Unleashed — the graveyard ability's picker leaves out the card exiled as its cost
notes: "{2}{B}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Put two +1/+1 counters on target creature. It gains deathtouch until end of turn." The card is in the graveyard when the ability is used and is exiled as the cost, so it cannot be a target; the picker listed Venom itself. Same for every "Exile this card from your graveyard:" cost (Renew, Beetle, Legacy Criminal, Symbiote Spider-Man).
